target_applications: whole-body manipulation research, large-object carrying, physical human interaction

base_type.value: stationary upper-body rig (no mobile base published)

dof_per_arm.source: off-the-shelf 7-DoF-class commercial arms per TRI description

payload_per_arm_kg.source: not disclosed; whole-body carries bulky 5-20kg-class objects (analyst estimate from demos)

actuators.value: commercial electric arms + pneumatic pressurization of tactile bubbles (stiffness control)

end_effector.value: fingerless 'paws': high-friction latex bubbles with internal camera tracking dot pattern for force/slip

sensors_wrist_hand.value: camera-based Soft-Bubble paw sensors (dense contact geometry + force)

sensors_base.value: n/a; 13 pressure-sensed bubbles per arm (~5cm compliance) + compliant chest force/geometry sensor

software_stack.value: TRI stack: teleop demonstrations, Diffusion Policy, plan-guided RL, Large Behavior Models; Drake simulation

safety_compliance.value: none (research); soft compliant surfaces as intrinsic pHRI safety

price.source: not for sale; Soft-Bubble gripper open-sourced

deployment_evidence.value: lab demos (jugs, boxes, laundry baskets, handovers); peer-reviewed papers; Soft-Bubble design replicated by other labs

notes: Research thesis: whole-body contact manipulation via air-filled tactile bubbles beats fingertip-only grasping for large objects. Context: TRI Diffusion Policy + LBM programs; 2024 Boston Dynamics partnership.
